about: plan 104 F4a: the skater's clips (tools/art/skate-anim). Her space: x her left, y up, z ahead; a regular rider (the board's nose to her left); joints three.js XYZ Euler; the board's turn three.js YXZ (roll, yaw, pitch) about its middle; feet and hands on the board in its own frame (street-pop's).

revert.note: the board and she slid round 180° the short way, in her frame (the root's already round)
